Message:
I-I knew I had to save everyone
who fell into the abyss...

but just the thought of
messing everything up again
made me freeze in fear...

After meeting the others,
every day I spent with them
was so much fun.
I even started to smile,
just a little...

I thought that maybe,
just maybe, I was finally
starting to be useful, but...

At this rate,
everyone’s going to die...
Then, I’d never be able
to see Guinevere again...!

No... No, no, no!
I can’t let that happen!

For once...just this once,
I can’t run away...!

If I didn’t do something now,
this would be it for all of us!

I-I know I’m a worthless
good-for-nothing, but...

Guinevere told me,
didn’t she—
that I had a gift!
That I could do anything
I put my mind to!

At that very moment,
something hot welled up
within my chest,
and all of the fairies
flew towards the others.
Then...

“I knew it.
I figured if anyone could do it,
it’d be you, Myrlennia.”

There she was behind me...
The one who betrayed us all...
Elaine...
